slides.text: Why you lose focus mid-afternoon, and a boring fix
Many people notice an energy dip after lunch. You are not broken. It is common.
Stop scheduling your hardest thinking for that window.
Put your most demanding work in the part of the day when your mind is clearest.
Use the dip for easy tasks: email, admin, filing, planning tomorrow.
A ten-minute walk and a glass of water beat another coffee more often than not.
Work with your energy instead of fighting it. Fewer hours, better output.
Save this before tomorrow's afternoon slump.
slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily

caption:
If your focus fades mid-afternoon, stop forcing it. Move hard work earlier and use the dip for easy tasks.
